items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-19
items.q: But I consider that there were a lot of great musicians that weren't from New Orleans, like Hody's, for example.

ctx.x: Are there any musicians that do not relate so much to the New Orleans style that you are particularly impressed by or with? Yeah, of course.

I was much impressed with Lips Page, whom I consider to be a great individual artist. I was impressed with Lucky Roberts, who's, I suppose, not only because of his music, but because of the environment of that place and that time. I was, of course, impressed with Pee Wee Russell, whom I was very fond of personally. That's a guy that I always enjoyed having around. And, of course, these are not New Orleans folks. I like, there were a lot of musicians that I liked personally, whose music I didn't like at all, which…
